column3: Scientific name of the organism as in the NCBI Taxonomy database. Scientific names typically follow the binomial nomenclature. For example, the scientific name for humans is Homo sapiens. NB! you don't need to provide this as it will be automatic fetched from the Tax ID in MetaTrack

column7: Describes the physical, environmental and/or local geographical source of the biological sample from which the sample was derived (example: feces, soil, hospital, nasal swab). Not applicable – Not relevant for this sample.
column8: The date the sample was collected with the intention of sequencing, either as an instance (single point in time) or interval. In case no exact time is available, the date/time can be right truncated i.e. all of these are valid ISO8601 compliant times (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss±hh:mm): 2008-01-23T19:23:10+00:00; 2008-01-23T19:23:10; 2008-01-23; 2008-01; 2008.
